# Benchmark Fixtures

All files in this directory are synthetic and generated by `generate.py`.
They contain no proprietary or personal data.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `sample.pdf` | Text-heavy 2-page PDF (exercises marker parser path) |
| `scanned.pdf` | Image-only 1-page PDF (forces OCR fallback) |
| `sample.pptx` | 3-slide presentation (exercises PPTX parser) |
| `sample.wav` | 15s mono 16 kHz sine sweep (exercises transcriber) |
| `queries.json` | 20 chat queries for latency benchmarking |
| `golden_set.json` | Hand-written + LLM-generated Q/A pairs for RAG quality eval |

## Regenerating fixtures

```bash
cd backend/tests/fixtures/benchmark
python generate.py
```
